title: Failed API responses cached as empty results; empty answers treated as errors
description: BaseProvider.analyzeFullText catches every error and returns createErrorResponse (BaseProvider.ts:35-40, apiUtils.ts:36-42); TextReplacerService.processTranslation caches it (TextReplacerService.ts:186-189) and the segment is marked processed for 4h. A 429/timeout poisons all identical segments for the page; users reload and pay for the whole page again. A legitimately empty model answer throws 'No valid replacement items' (OpenAIProvider.ts:95-98) and is indistinguishable from failure. Blocker for every cache work item.
acceptance_criteria: FullTextAnalysisResponse gets status 'ok'|'empty'|'error'; errors never cached; empty answers cached as success; retry 408/429/5xx only (max 2, exp backoff + jitter, honour Retry-After).
notes: Track C (fb9152e): status ok/empty/error, errors never cached, failed segments released for retry. Remaining: retry 408/429/5xx with backoff (track B transport).
close_reason: Implemented in track B (507c176) + track C (fb9152e). ei3.6: per-tab limiter + global active-tab-priority limiter; hidden-tab deferral covered by background priority only.

title: DomWalker full-body scan blocks main thread (style reads interleaved with attribute writes)
description: ProcessingService.ts:59,74 runs getSegments(document.body) on the whole page even in lazy mode. Per element: element.textContent of whole subtree (DomWalker.ts:73), getComputedStyle twice (DomWalker.ts:78, DomTranslationPolicy.ts:127), closest() with 18 selectors (DomTranslationPolicy.ts:112-115), up to 3 setAttribute (DomWalker.ts:176,196,202-204) then clearLabels querySelectorAll + 4x removeAttribute (DomWalker.ts:213-228). Per paragraph querySelectorAll (DomWalker.ts:263). isTranslatableTextNode walks all ancestors with getComputedStyle -> O(depth^2) (DomTranslationPolicy.ts:74-85). Never yields -> multi-second long task on large pages; attribute churn floods page MutationObservers.
acceptance_criteria: Single pass with per-walk WeakMap style cache; no DOM attribute labelling (WeakSet/Map instead); TreeWalker FILTER_REJECT pruning; time-sliced with scheduler.yield/requestIdleCallback (<=5ms slices); lazy mode only segments near viewport. Long task < 50ms on a long Wikipedia article.
close_reason: Implemented in track A, merged in 9dbc0d9

title: Paragraph mode: full-page start() runs once per mutated node
description: ListenerService.ts:256-258 loops topLevelNodes and awaits processDynamicNode; in paragraph mode that calls paragraphService.start() (ListenerService.ts:276-278) which ignores the node and does getUserSettings + detectPageLanguage (body.innerText) + walkAndCollectParagraphs(document.body) + O(P^2) selectParagraphTranslationElements (ParagraphTranslationSelection.ts:80-82). 20 new feed items => 20 sequential full-page scans every debounce.
acceptance_criteria: At most one scan per debounce batch, scoped to the mutated subtrees (translateWithin(nodes)).
close_reason: Implemented in track A, merged in 9dbc0d9

title: Perf: fix browser/PC freezes caused by content script
description: Main-thread blocking, forced layouts, unbounded concurrency and hangs found in the 2026-10-08 resource audit. See docs/RESOURCE_AUDIT.md section 2.

title: Browser verification of resource/cost audit fixes (tracks A-G)

title: Paragraph mode: respect replacement rate
description: Paragraph mode translates every paragraph; with hidden display this replaces the whole page. Apply the replacementRate setting to translate only that share of paragraphs, spread evenly through the page and stable across rescans/lazy loading.
close_reason: Closed

title: Hidden display + paragraph mode shows both original and translated paragraph
description: With originalWordDisplayMode=HIDDEN and translationMode=PARAGRAPH, the translated paragraph is inserted but the original stays visible. Hidden mode should hide the original paragraph (consistent with word mode).
close_reason: Closed

title: Persistent cross-tab translation memory (IndexedDB in background)
description: Approach B1 in docs/RESOURCE_AUDIT.md. New TranslationMemoryService singleton in background: IndexedDB store tm_segments keyed sha256(fp + '\n' + normText) (128-bit, base64url); value {pairs, status ok|empty, createdAt, lastAccess, hits}; L1 Map; fp = sha256 of {schema, provider family, endpoint origin, model, temperature, customParams, thinking, actual system prompt string, user prefix}. TTL 30d ok / 3d empty, cap ~20k entries (~8MB), LRU evict 10% debounced. Incognito tabs (sender.tab.incognito) use L1 only. Messages tm-lookup (batched) / tm-store / tm-clear / tm-stats. Hook in TextReplacerService.processTranslation after L0 miss + prefetch per coordinator batch. Hashing in background (crypto.subtle unavailable on http pages, cf. DomWalker.ts:47-49). Optionally add unlimitedStorage. Saves ~100% on reload/back/session restore, 30-70% on revisited feeds, 5-20% across pages of the same site (estimates).
acceptance_criteria: Reloading a translated page makes 0 API calls; cache survives SW restart and browser restart; config change (model/prompt/level) misses cleanly.
close_reason: Implemented in track D, merged in d3d4295

title: Batch multiple segments per LLM request (numbered I/O) with exact dedup
description: Biggest token lever: the ~400-600 token system prompt (PromptService.ts:23-117) is resent per ~100-token segment (OpenAIProvider.ts:30-46, GoogleGeminiProvider.ts:63-69); prompt is below OpenAI's 1024-token auto prompt-cache threshold. Replace loop in ProcessingCoordinator.ts:174-214: group identical segments, send ~2-3k chars per request as <1>..</1>, output 'n|orig||trans', StructuredTextParser.parseNumbered, per-item fallback. LazyLoadingService already gathers visible segments every 100ms (:135). Then drop/relax mergeSmallSegments (ContentSegmenter.ts:153-181) which defeats exact dedup. Est. ~70% less input, ~35% lower cost (estimate, verify with instrumentation). Approach A3.
acceptance_criteria: Measured tokens/page reduced >=50% on a reference article with equal replacement quality.
close_reason: Implemented in track C, merged in fb9152e (eq7.1 core part — no error caching — is merged; only retry remains)

title: In-page segment cache: full key, LRU, in-flight promise coalescing
description: TextReplacerService cache (TextReplacerService.ts:53-59,238-302): 32-bit djb2 key of {text,targetLang,level,rate} - omits provider/model/prompt (stale results after model switch, collision risk), 100 entries FIFO, written only after await so identical segments in the same batch of 8 (and across overlapping coordinators) each send a request. Approach A1 in docs/RESOURCE_AUDIT.md.
acceptance_criteria: Key = provider id + model + target + level + rate + prompt hash + normalized text (no 32-bit hash); LRU ~500 entries; store pairs only and recompute positions per caller via addPositionsToReplacements; Map<key,Promise> in-flight dedup.
close_reason: Implemented in track C, merged in fb9152e (eq7.1 core part — no error caching — is merged; only retry remains)

title: SegmentObserver/LazyLoading keep every segment forever; split paragraphs overwrite each other
description: SegmentObserver.segmentMap: Map<Element, ContentSegment> (SegmentObserver.ts:29,111) never pruned; processed elements never unobserve()d so IO keeps firing on scroll; LazyLoadingService.processedSegments (:56,170) never cleared; globalProcessingState keeps fingerprints 4h with domPath strings (ProcessingStateManager.ts:57-60). Virtualised feeds => detached DOM retained. Correctness bug: segmentMap is keyed by element, so sub-segments of a split long paragraph overwrite each other and only the last part gets translated (SegmentObserver.ts:111). updateConfig recreates the observer and drops all observed segments (LazyLoadingService.ts:254-256).
acceptance_criteria: unobserve + delete after processing; WeakMap/WeakSet; key segments by id (element -> segment[]); LRU cap on fingerprint stores.
close_reason: Implemented in track A, merged in 9dbc0d9

title: Pronunciation registry: strong Map<HTMLElement>, 2 listeners per word, full-map scans per hover
description: TooltipInteractionController.ts:39-42 Map<HTMLElement,...>; register() (:56-91) adds 2 closures per word (:195-201) plus data-wxt-id; unregister/removePronunciationFromElement have no callers; PronunciationService.destroy() never called (ContentManager.destroy :262-270). cleanupOtherTooltips (:321-338) iterates the whole map + document.querySelectorAll on each show; cancelAllMainTooltipHideTimers (:629-633) too. Memory and hover cost grow with every word ever translated.
acceptance_criteria: One delegated mouseover/mouseout on document with closest('.wxt-pronunciation-enabled'); WeakMap or attribute-derived data; track only the single visible tooltip.
close_reason: Implemented in track E, merged in 63d28ed

title: sendViaBackground hangs forever when response is undefined
description: src/modules/api/utils/requestUtils.ts:28-62 wraps runtime.sendMessage callback in a Promise and reads response.success without a null guard. If the SW restarted / port closed, the callback throws, resolve is never called, the segment stays in activeProcessing and LazyLoadingService processingTimer (LazyLoadingService.ts:130-131,166) is never cleared => lazy translation dead for the tab. UNVERIFIED: Firefox promise-only browser.runtime.sendMessage may ignore the callback entirely.
acceptance_criteria: await browser.runtime.sendMessage in try/catch, guard response?.success, resolve ok:false on failure. Test on Firefox.
close_reason: Implemented in track B (507c176) + track C (fb9152e). ei3.6: per-tab limiter + global active-tab-priority limiter; hidden-tab deferral covered by background priority only.

title: No default API timeout and no request cancellation
description: apiRequestTimeout: 0 (defaults.ts:91) -> getApiTimeout returns undefined (src/utils/index.ts:81-82) -> ApiProxyService never aborts. ApiProxyService defaultTimeout 30000 / maxRetries / retryDelay (ApiProxyService.ts:19-21) are unused; activeRequests never filled so cancelAllRequests() is a no-op. In-flight requests keep running (and are billed) after navigation, tab close, or disable.
acceptance_criteria: Default 30s timeout via AbortController; per-tab port (runtime.connect) and abort on port.onDisconnect/pagehide/destroy.
close_reason: Implemented in track B (507c176) + track C (fb9152e). ei3.6: per-tab limiter + global active-tab-priority limiter; hidden-tab deferral covered by background priority only.

title: No global request concurrency cap; hidden/background tabs translate immediately
description: Per-tab batchSize 8 (ProcessingCoordinator.ts:165), paragraph 5 (ParagraphTranslationService.ts:42-43). Rate limiter is per content script and off by default (requestsPerSecond 0 -> enabled false, RateLimiterService.ts:130), UniversalApiService does not use it, ApiProxyService forwards immediately. A new ProcessingCoordinator per call (ProcessingService.ts:131) makes its serial queue useless across manual/lazy/dynamic runs. No document.hidden/visibilitychange check anywhere; SegmentObserver.emitIfInitiallyVisible translates first screen of background tabs. 10 tabs => ~80 concurrent fetches + DOM work (session restore!).
acceptance_criteria: Global semaphore in background (3-4 concurrent, active tab prioritised); hidden tabs defer until visible; one shared coordinator/queue per tab.
notes: Per-tab part done in track C (fb9152e): one shared coordinator + ConcurrencyLimiter(4). Remaining: global background semaphore (track B).
close_reason: Implemented in track B (507c176) + track C (fb9152e). ei3.6: per-tab limiter + global active-tab-priority limiter; hidden-tab deferral covered by background priority only.

title: Web Speech TTS initialised on every page load (speech-dispatcher on Linux)
description: PronunciationService.ts:38-43 always creates fallback web-speech provider; WebSpeechTTSProvider constructor calls initialize() -> speechSynthesis.getVoices() and overwrites onvoiceschanged (WebSpeechTTSProvider.ts:27,47,54-57). PronunciationService is built by TextProcessorService singleton during ContentManager.initializeServices on every enabled page. On Linux getVoices() can spawn/connect speech-dispatcher, which is known to stall/burn CPU -> plausible cause of whole-PC hangs. UNVERIFIED on user machine: check 'pgrep -a speech-dispatcher' and its CPU while opening tabs.
acceptance_criteria: No speechSynthesis access until first speak(); providers created lazily; addEventListener('voiceschanged') instead of overwriting the handler.
close_reason: Implemented in track E, merged in 63d28ed

title: MutationObserver: debounce starves, node set unbounded, heavy work in callback
description: ListenerService.ts:223-238 observes body {childList,subtree,characterData}; trailing-only 150ms debounce resets every batch, so on pages mutating faster (chats, tickers, timestamps) it never fires while nodesToProcess (closure Set, :192) keeps growing incl. detached nodes. Callback runs isTranslationCandidateNode (DomTranslationPolicy.ts:99-104): textContent of the added subtree + getComputedStyle on fresh nodes + closest(). Also: observer is disconnected across awaited API calls (:251-271) - mutations during that window are lost for good, and with no timeout it may stay disconnected forever.
acceptance_criteria: maxWait (~750ms) on debounce; cap set size with fallback to common-ancestor scan; callback does only cheap checks; drop characterData or ignore tiny text; never disconnect across await (self-mutation flag / takeRecords).
close_reason: Implemented in track A, merged in 9dbc0d9

title: detectPageLanguage reads document.body.innerText (full forced layout) on every load and paragraph
description: LanguageService.ts:227 document.body.innerText.substring(0,1000). Called at every page load even in MANUAL mode (ContentManager.ts:318), every ParagraphTranslationService.start() (ParagraphTranslationService.ts:108), and per paragraph (ParagraphTranslationApi.ts:69) - even when targetLanguage was passed, because detection runs before the 'targetLanguage ||' short-circuit. Interleaved with DOM writes => layout thrashing.
acceptance_criteria:
Detect once per page and cache; use first, then textContent sample of a few

/

; skip entirely when targetLanguage known; defer until translation actually starts.
close_reason: Implemented in track A, merged in 9dbc0d9

title: API cost: dedup, caching and batching of translation requests
description: One request per ~400-char segment with the ~400-600 token system prompt repeated each time (75-85% of input tokens). No cross-page cache, no in-flight dedup, failures cached as empty results. See docs/RESOURCE_AUDIT.md section 4.

Expose in options DataManagement stats.

title: Nested inline paragraphs may produce overlapping segments (duplicate API calls)
description:
Inline child with own text (// in

) is labelled as paragraph (DomWalker.ts:195-196) and parent

kept because the child is inline (:266-277). Different domPath => different fingerprints => child >=20 chars becomes a second segment over the same text nodes => second API call, whose ranges then fail validation (ProcessingCoordinator.ts:475). INFERRED from code, not reproduced on a live page.

title: Paragraph mode: no cache, settings + language re-resolved per paragraph

title: Persist hover definitions; in-flight dedup + negative caching for definitions & phonetics
description: AITranslationProvider (AITranslationProvider.ts:33-36,80-88,145,204-208,246-277) caches 500 words per tab only, so every new tab pays again for each hovered word; failures not cached so every hover after 300ms re-calls the LLM. DictionaryApiProvider 404s not cached (:62-68). No dedup of concurrent hovers. Approach B2a.

title: Route Gemini through background (cache + concurrency + bundle size)
description: GoogleGeminiProvider calls @google/generative-ai SDK directly from the content script (GoogleGeminiProvider.ts:29,76-78; UniversalApiService.ts:15,151), bypassing ApiProxyService, so any background cache or global semaphore misses Gemini. The SDK is also bundled into the content script on every page (also pulled via src/utils/index.ts:13 just for getApiTimeout).
acceptance_criteria: All provider calls go through one background entry point; content bundle no longer contains the Gemini SDK.
close_reason: Implemented in track B (507c176) + track C (fb9152e). ei3.6: per-tab limiter + global active-tab-priority limiter; hidden-tab deferral covered by background priority only.

title: Shorten system prompt and cap output tokens; skip calls when budget exhausted
description: System prompt ~1.6-2.5k chars (PromptService.ts:23-117). No max_tokens on word/paragraph requests (OpenAIProvider.ts:36-46, GoogleGeminiProvider.ts:32-34, ParagraphTranslationApi.ts:84). Model asked for up to ~30% of words but surplus dropped client-side (textUtils.ts:65-96, ReplacementBudget.take at ProcessingCoordinator.ts:330); API still called after page budget is exhausted (fetch at :176-178 precedes budget check). enable_thinking only sent when includeThinkingParam set (OpenAIProvider.ts:48-50) so thinking models may bill reasoning tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt asks for at most N = calculateReplacementLimit(segment) lines; max_tokens ~ N*15+20; skip request when budget.remaining <= 0; thinking off by default; prompt trimmed.
close_reason: Implemented in track C, merged in fb9152e

title: Context menu recomputed on title changes of any tab; listeners lost after SW restart
description: ContextMenuManager.ts:394-452 recomputes on tabs.onUpdated (url/status/title of ANY tab), onActivated, webNavigation.onCommitted; each = storage read + ~9 sequential contextMenus.update. Background tabs with ticking titles generate constant IPC and can overwrite active tab state. On Chrome listeners are only registered in onInstalled path (InitializationService.ts:51-52) so they vanish after SW restart (functional bug).
acceptance_criteria: Register listeners synchronously at top level; only active tab; drop title trigger; debounce; update only changed menus.
close_reason: Implemented in track F, merged in bb7d63e

title: Options page writes full settings to storage.sync on every keystroke/slider tick
description: Deep watchers without debounce in BasicSettings.vue:588-603, AppearanceSettings.vue:143-153, TranslationSettings.vue:1125-1137; each saves + sends settings_updated (no background handler -> 'Unknown message type', wakes SW). Fires on mount too. storage.sync limits (120 writes/min, 8KB/item) => silent save failures. Popup has a double-save in handleActiveConfigChange (popup/App.vue:219-232).
acceptance_criteria: 300-500ms debounce, skip initial load, consider storage.local or split keys.
close_reason: Implemented in track F, merged in bb7d63e

title: GitHub update check runs on every MV3 service-worker cold start
description: UpdateCheckService.ts:68-77 setTimeout(checkForUpdates, 10000) + 24h setInterval; MV3 SW dies after ~30s idle so the interval never fires but initializeServices (background.ts:269) re-runs on every wake (every page load wakes it). lastUpdateCheck is stored (:414) but never used to gate. Can exceed GitHub's 60/h unauthenticated limit.
acceptance_criteria: browser.alarms periodInMinutes 1440, or gate on lastUpdateCheck older than 24h.
close_reason: Implemented in track F, merged in bb7d63e

title: Content init does storage IPC + SW wake-up before isEnabled/blacklist check
description: ContentManager.init (ContentManager.ts:220-246): website-rules storage read, then validateConfiguration message to background (:303-307, wakes MV3 SW on every page load), then settings read, only then isEnabled; then detectPageLanguage, floating ball, services. A disabled extension still costs 2 storage IPCs + 1 SW wake per page.
acceptance_criteria: Read settings once, check isEnabled + blacklist first; validate API key locally; defer heavy init and language detection until translation starts.
close_reason: Implemented in track F, merged in bb7d63e

title: No ctx.onInvalidated / incomplete destroy(); beforeunload blocks bfcache
description: entrypoints/content.ts:12 ignores WXT ctx; after extension update/reload orphaned scripts keep MutationObserver/IntersectionObserver/floating ball running and every batch fails with 'Extension context invalidated'. destroy() only runs on beforeunload (content.ts:24), which makes Firefox pages bfcache-ineligible, and does not remove onMessage listener, tooltip document listeners, ProcessingStateManager setInterval (:241), floating ball. No SPA route-change handling.
acceptance_criteria: ctx.onInvalidated(() => manager.destroy()); use ctx.addEventListener/ctx.setTimeout; pagehide instead of beforeunload; destroy() tears down every observer, listener, interval, in-flight request.
close_reason: Implemented in track F, merged in bb7d63e

title: generateDomPath is O(siblings) per ancestor level
description: ProcessingStateManager.ts:107-110 Array.from(siblings).indexOf(current) at every level, called for every paragraph (ContentSegmenter.ts:51, ParagraphTranslationService.ts:458). Quadratic on long lists/feeds; merged segments concatenate several paths (ContentSegmenter.ts:187).
acceptance_criteria: Use WeakMap<Element,id> identity instead of path strings.
close_reason: Implemented in track A, merged in 9dbc0d9

title: Expensive paint: backdrop-filter blur, infinite shimmer, per-word filter blur
description: Tooltip cards use backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%) on a 92% opaque background (styles/components/tooltip.ts:91-92,361-362,514-515). Shimmer loaders animate background-position infinitely (tooltip.ts:42-45,203,257,273; pronunciation.ts:32,106) and are never replaced on load failure (TooltipInteractionController.ts:545-547,587-596), tooltip stays when hovered element is removed (:277-290). Learning style puts filter: blur(5px) on every translated word (base.ts:31-51, themes/translation.ts:61-85). Floating ball: infinite pulse animation on every page (FloatingBallManager.ts:607), hidden panel keeps backdrop-filter at opacity 0 (:314-316,637-643), non-passive document touchmove (:802-826). Paint cost UNVERIFIED by profiling.
acceptance_criteria: Remove backdrop-filter; static/opacity loader with error state; hide tooltip if !element.isConnected; cheaper learning-mode concealment; ball pulse only on hover + prefers-reduced-motion; panel display:none when closed; drag listeners attached only during drag.
close_reason: Implemented in track E, merged in 63d28ed

title: Global stylesheet injected 3x; global @keyframes spin collides with page
description: StyleManager.ts:75-85 guards only per instance; instantiated in ContentManager.ts:342, TextReplacerService.ts:66, ParagraphTranslationService.ts:57 => three <style id='wxt-main-styles'> with ALL_STYLES (~1100 lines) plus a 4th sheet from TextProcessorService.ts:114-227. base.ts:133 declares unprefixed '@keyframes spin'.
acceptance_criteria: Inject once (module-level guard or adoptedStyleSheets); rename keyframes to wxt-spin.
close_reason: Implemented in track E, merged in 63d28ed

title: getUserSettings hits storage.sync on hot paths without cache (incl. write-on-read)
description: StorageService.getUserSettings (StorageService.ts:147-176): storage.sync.get + JSON.parse + validate + 2x JSON.stringify compare (:538-543), may write back (:160-162). Called per API request (UniversalApiService.ts:425), twice per paragraph (ParagraphTranslationApi.ts:67 + callAI), on every mouseenter of a translated word via checkHotkey (TooltipInteractionController.ts:181,216) even when tooltips are disabled, on every Ctrl keydown (:670). No storage.onChanged listener in the repo. Also returns DEFAULT_SETTINGS by reference (:154) and ListenerService.ts:177 Object.assign can mutate global defaults.
acceptance_criteria: In-memory settings cache per context invalidated by a single storage.onChanged listener; no writes inside getUserSettings; return clones.
close_reason: Implemented in track E, merged in 63d28ed

title: Do not bake VITE_WXT_DEFAULT_API_KEY into the extension bundle
description:
src/modules/shared/constants/defaults.ts:28 sets DEFAULT_API_CONFIG.apiKey = import.meta.env.VITE_WXT_DEFAULT_API_KEY. Vite inlines that value into the built JS, so any key placed in .env ships in plaintext inside .output/*.zip. Anyone with the zip (store upload, GitHub release asset, shared build) can extract it. CLAUDE.md and README tell contributors to put a real key in .env, which makes leaking it easy.

.env is gitignored, so the key does not leak via git. It only leaks via build artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Production builds contain no API key: either drop the env-based default key, or gate it behind a dev-only mode and fail the production build when it is set. Docs updated so .env is not presented as the place for a personal key that ends up in shareable builds.

title: Update dependencies with known vulnerabilities (npm audit: 45, 4 critical)
description:
npm audit --package-lock-only reports 45 vulnerabilities: 4 critical, 34 high, 6 moderate, 1 low. All are in dev/build tooling, not in the shipped extension runtime.

Critical: tar (hardlink/symlink path traversal), shell-quote, fx-runner and web-ext-run (via spawn-sync/shell-quote; used when wxt launches a browser).
Notable high: vite <=6.4.2 (dev-server file disclosure / server.fs bypass), rollup 4.0-4.58 (arbitrary file write via path traversal), wxt <=0.20.18, lint-staged, typescript-eslint 8.2-8.47, @intlify/unplugin-vue-i18n, vue <=3.5.41 (SSR-only XSS, not used here), lodash, js-yaml, node-forge, postcss, picomatch, minimatch, braces, ws.

Practical risk is low for local use: the vite dev server binds to localhost by default, so don't run it with --host on untrusted networks until this is fixed.
acceptance_criteria: Bump direct deps (wxt, typescript-eslint, lint-staged, @intlify/unplugin-vue-i18n, vue) and run npm audit fix. npm audit shows no critical/high findings, or each remaining one is documented as not applicable. npm run compile, npm run lint and npm run build pass.

title: Security review of cloned repo (2026-10-08)
description:
Pre-run security review of the illa-helper fork. Verdict: no malicious code found; safe to install and run locally.

Checked and clean:
- npm lifecycle scripts: postinstall = 'wxt prepare', prepare = 'husky'. Deps with install scripts are only esbuild, @tailwindcss/oxide, vue-demi, fsevents (macOS only), spawn-sync (via fx-runner) - all legitimate.
- Lockfile integrity: all 734 tarball hashes match registry.npmjs.org, even though they resolve via npmmirror. Installed node_modules (673 pkgs) match the lockfile exactly. No hits against the Sept 2025 chalk/debug compromise or Shai-Hulud package versions.
- Build/dev configs (wxt.config.ts, eslint.config.js, .prettierrc.cjs, tailwind.config.js): no network calls, no child_process, nothing obfuscated.
- .husky/pre-commit only runs vue-tsc and lint-staged. scripts/release.js runs only when invoked manually.
- Extension: no eval / new Function / remote script loading, no onMessageExternal / externally_connectable / window.postMessage bridge. Translations are rendered with textContent, not innerHTML.
- Network destinations: user-configured LLM endpoint, api.github.com (update check), api.dictionaryapi.dev, dict.youdao.com (TTS). Default triggerMode is MANUAL, so page text is only sent when the user triggers translation.

Child issues track the hardening items found.

title: Add token/cost benchmark script (upstream baseline vs HEAD)
description: Keep the word-mode token benchmark used for the post-audit estimate: runs real articles through the frozen upstream 2a6c3d6 prompt (1 request per segment, merged small segments) and the current PromptService/batch chunker/replacement limits, counts o200k tokens and estimates gpt-4o-mini cost at several lazy-loading batch fills. Lives in scripts/, run via npm run bench:tokens.
close_reason: scripts/benchmark-tokens.mjs + npm run bench:tokens; baseline prompt verified identical to 2a6c3d6 for 245 configs

title: Options: translation cache stats / toggle / clear
description: Add block in entrypoints/options/components/data/DataManagement.vue: entries, size, hits, est. requests saved, enable toggle, 'Clear translation cache', optional 'Clear word history'. Settings translationCache {enabled,maxEntries,ttlDays} in UserSettings (shared/types/storage.ts) + DEFAULT_SETTINGS; excluded from settings export. i18n keys in all locales.
acceptance_criteria: User can see and clear the cache; disabling stops reads and writes.
close_reason: Implemented in track D, merged in d3d4295

title: Page-level word glossary: local reuse + 'already handled' prompt hint (opt-in)
description: Approach A2. PageGlossary owned by ProcessingService next to pageReplacementBudget (not by the per-call coordinator). Learn applied LLM pairs (exact surface form, len>=3, stop reuse on conflicting translation); findIn(raw text) with Unicode word boundaries merged under LLM picks and capped by limitReplacementsByRate; per-segment hint 'Already handled, do NOT output: w1, w2' (only words present in that segment). Saves output tokens (~10-30% est.), gives consistent translations. Risks: polysemy, inflection, CJK substrings. Note: today a repeated word does NOT cause extra requests - it costs output tokens inside requests that happen anyway.
acceptance_criteria: Behind a setting; wrong-sense rate measured on reference pages before enabling by default.
close_reason: Implemented in track G, merged in aa41205 (opt-in, default off; wrong-sense rate still to be measured before enabling by default)

title: Floating ball: dead click after re-enable, duplicate menu handlers
description: destroy() clears onTranslateCallback (FloatingBallManager.ts:1624) so after disable->enable via updateConfig (:114-127) clicks do nothing. closeBall() resets menuItemsEventsBound (:1397) without removing listeners; next showMenuOnHover (:1243-1246) binds again => translate fires twice. Dead code toggleMenu (:1280-1299) stacks document listeners.
acceptance_criteria: Callbacks survive re-enable; listeners bound exactly once; remove dead code.
close_reason: Implemented in track E, merged in 63d28ed

title: Point update check and release script at the fork, not upstream
description:
This is a fork (origin: eliTruckoo/illa-helper), but hardcoded references still point at upstream xiao-zaiyi/illa-helper:
- src/modules/background/services/UpdateCheckService.ts:49 polls api.github.com/repos/xiao-zaiyi/illa-helper/releases/latest. Clicking the update notification opens that repo's release page (lines 303, 319), so self-built users get nudged to install upstream builds over their own.
- scripts/release.js runs 'gh repo set-default xiao-zaiyi/illa-helper' and prints upstream Actions/Releases URLs.
- wxt.config.ts manifest author email is the upstream author's.
- OptionsNavigation.vue:188 opens https://illa.xlike.cc (upstream's site).
acceptance_criteria: Upstream repo/owner are config constants pointing at the fork (or the update check can be disabled). npm run release targets the fork. Manifest author and external links reviewed.

title: Restrict background ApiProxyService to configured API endpoints
description:
src/modules/background/services/ApiProxyService.ts:40-60 fetch()es whatever url, method, headers and body arrive in an API_REQUEST message. The extension holds <all_urls> host permissions, so this is an unrestricted fetch proxy with the extension's privileges. That means no CORS limits and access to intranet/localhost.

Today only the extension's own contexts can reach it: there is no onMessageExternal, externally_connectable or postMessage bridge. So this is defense-in-depth, not an exploitable bug. Any future bug that lets page-controlled data reach the content-script message path would turn into SSRF.
acceptance_criteria: The proxy only allows URLs whose origin matches an apiEndpoint in the stored apiConfigs (or a small fixed allowlist), and checks sender.id === browser.runtime.id. Anything else is rejected.

title: API keys are synced via storage.sync and exported in plaintext
description:
StorageService (src/modules/core/storage/StorageService.ts:149,194) stores the whole UserSettings blob, including apiConfigs[].config.apiKey, in browser.storage.sync. Keys are therefore synced to the user's Google or Firefox account and every synced device, and storage.sync is unencrypted at rest in the profile.

DataManagement.vue exportSettings (entrypoints/options/components/data/DataManagement.vue:71-90) writes the full settings, keys included, to a plaintext JSON download.

Related: custom endpoints may be http://, and ApiProxyService then sends 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' in cleartext.
acceptance_criteria: API keys live in storage.local (or session), separate from the synced settings blob. Export omits or masks keys by default, with an explicit opt-in to include them. The UI warns or blocks when an http:// endpoint is configured with a key.

title: Word exposure tracking / known words (learning layer)
description: Approach B2 learning layer: tm_words store {translations, exposures, hovers, firstSeen, lastSeen, known}. Skip known words in applySegmentTranslation so the budget goes to new words. Learning feature, not a cost saver; do NOT inject the glossary into the prompt (adds input tokens).
close_reason: Implemented in track D, merged in d3d4295

title: Economy mode: skip LLM for segments already covered by glossary
description: Approach A4. If glossary.findIn(segment) >= calculateReplacementLimit(segment), apply local replacements and skip the request. Rarely triggers at rate 0.3; useful at 0.05-0.1 on long single-topic articles. Pedagogical downside: later paragraphs stop introducing new words.
acceptance_criteria: Opt-in only; at most every other segment skipped.
close_reason: Implemented in track G, merged in aa41205 (opt-in, default off; wrong-sense rate still to be measured before enabling by default)

title: Rename or harden safeSetInnerHTML: it is not safe for untrusted input
description: src/utils/index.ts:329 safeSetInnerHTML parses with DOMParser, then moves the nodes into the live document. Script tags stay inert, but event-handler attributes (e.g. ) DO fire once inserted. So this is equivalent to innerHTML for XSS purposes despite the name. Current callers (FloatingBallManager.ts:147,240,1480) only pass static templates built from MENU_ACTIONS constants, so nothing is exploitable today. The risk is a future caller passing LLM output or page text because the name says it is safe. ParagraphTranslationService.ts:385 also uses innerHTML for a constant SVG (fine).
acceptance_criteria: Rename to e.g. setTrustedStaticHTML with a doc comment forbidding untrusted input, or build these nodes with createElement/textContent. Optionally add an ESLint no-restricted-properties rule for innerHTML.
